notes.title: Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon... OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027701/31d6e28ccedca594e9c08805cf2fef006c8bf61f.png[/img]
The time has come! Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon is upon us! Side-scrolling strategy extraordinaire is back!

The delicious apocalypse is here - you can download and play the game right now… with a 10% launch discount and even an extra 10% loyalty discount if you own Swords and Soldiers HD or Awesomenauts! Take command of rowdy Vikings, ancient Persians or ferocious Demons. Follow Chief Redbeard on a 10 hour single-player campaign, or battle it out in split-screen or online multiplayer battles! 

Check out the launch trailer!
https://youtu.be/pw3GT5JlEGs

If you literally like the sound of the game, you can buy a special pack featuring the awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9182]soundtrack[/url] alongside the game. Speaking of awesome, we have something special for Awesomenauts players! Meet Helgø Scoop, a Viking that has traveled the nine realms all by himself! Helgø will be available to every Awesomenauts player who also owns a copy of Shawarmageddon!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027701/59b881eb8b838df71c4ab5b2ea835f644dae27dd.png[/img]

If you'd like to talk to us, the developers or the game, tune in for an ask-me-anything session on r/AMA this Thursday! Join us [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/AMA] on Reddit[/url] on the 8th of November at 15:00 CET, and fire your questions at the five partaking Ronimo developers: Senior Animator Koen, Lead Programmer Joost, Game Designer and Co-Founder Jasper, our Community Manager Niel, and Senior Producer Robin.

Last but not least, thank you to everyone who partook in our multiplayer beta test - your feedback has been invaluable! We hope you’re all looking forward to experiencing the full game ;)

Please [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=22]let us know your thoughts and feedback on our forums[/url] or [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/ronimo]the official Ronimo Discord[/url], so we can continue and improve the game as we go!

notes.title: Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon releases November 6!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1708351/2d10a5c8fb4549957ce614fca981a2ff36f252a0.png[/img]
The sequel to Swords and Soldiers is arriving on PC at last! The Vikings return, this time battling Persians and Demons! It’s got more of everything you loved about Swords and Soldiers, plus new features like hero units, a custom army builder, and of course a fresh 10 hour campaign. Chief Redbeard returns, as mysterious missing sheep and a search for a magic lamp becomes a race to prevent delicious apocalypse!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UHFQv_oKa8

notes.title: Ronimo announce Swords & Soldiers 2, give away the 1st
notes.content:
It’s quickly becoming A Thing in some circles that when you announce a sequel, you just throw the original at people for free. That’s definitely what Awesomenauts studio Ronimo are doing today. Alongside the announcement a PC launch (it’s been out on consoles for yonks) for silly side-scrolling strategy game Swords & Soldiers 2: Shawarmageddon, they’ve made the original Swords and Soldiers HD free to grab on Steam for the next 24 hours and keep forever. So go do that.

(more…)

notes.title: Free for a Limited Time - Swords & Soldiers HD!
notes.content:
For a limited time, get Swords & Soldiers HD free!* Add the game to your Steam account now, and keep it forever!

Rewrite history as you take control of the brutal Vikings, the devious Aztecs or the crafty Chinese in their global quest to win the favour of the Gods! Swords & Soldiers is a side-scrolling strategy game that lets you control an entire army and lets you wield devastating magical abilities.

Love the original? Check out Swords & Soldiers II Shawarmageddon coming to Steam this Fall!

*Offer ends June 20 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Announcing Swords & Soldiers II Shawarmageddon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1708351/ddeaf023914e2a74ebdb417848296eed500da64c.png[/img]Side-scrolling strategy is back, baby! We're super excited to announce the sequel to Swords & Soldiers HD is coming to Steam in just a few months!

Swords & Soldiers II Shawarmageddon brings back Redbeard the Viking as he travels the world, uncovers a mystery involving missing sheep, and chases a magic lamp across different continents. On top of that, the game allows to take to online multiplayer with the Viking armies, Demon hordes, and magic carpet-riding Persians!

Like the original, you gather resources, send out armies, and support your forces with a wide arsenal of magical spells - all from a side-scrolling perspective. That doesn’t mean Swords & Soldiers II Shawarmageddon is easy to master, as only the most cunning of Chiefs can lead their side to victory! Think you're beard enough? Prove it!

The sequel is now available for pre-order on Steam, and we're giving the original Swords & Soldiers HD away for 24 hours to celebrate. All you have to do is visit the store page of the original and add the game to your cart... and it'll be yours to keep forever!

Additionally, we've [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ronimo/swords-and-soldiers-ii-shawarmageddon]launched a Kickstarter campaign to add additional content to Swords & Soldiers II Shawarmageddon[/url]. Check out the campaign for more information on the rewards we have available, as well as the additional content that we've got lined up!
